data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'q-z-y' which means 'to meet', 'to encounter'. The name Muqazi refers to someone who has been met or encountered, either in a physical or spiritual sense. The name Muqazi carries the meaning “Encountered, Met” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muqazi usually hope their child will grow to embody encountered, met and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Muqazi is also mentioned in the historical work 'Al-Aghani' by Abul Faraj Al-Isfahani, as one of the most notable poets of the pre-Islamic era. He is particularly remembered for his skillful use of metaphor and his ability to write in various poetic forms.
